body: Paramjit Singh Soni (Promoter, Executive Director & Vice-Chairman) on the Q3FY25 call (2025-02-07), prompted: "I'm hoping to add another third platform, which gives us at least maybe 25%, 30% of our sales" Metric: Revenue share from third platform. Target: 25-30% of sales. Deadline: 2027-03-31 (vague). Specificity: vague. Status as of 2026-11-19: MOVED-GOALPOST. Evidence: No acquisition. The third platform is now presented as organic small/mid fabrication, targeted at 'high single digits, if not 10% of revenue' in 18-24 months (Nov-26), down from 25-30% of sales. From Aug-26 the Chairman already calls fabrication one of 'our 3 product platforms' at <2% of revenue (analyst figure, not disputed).
